text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Anăzmay wan tăzoli ăzǝjăylăl fal amăn fal eses n ănmidas.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Eses n ănmidăs ǝtaj alwaq wa ǝd molekil wǝ fal arori n aman ǝknan anǝrkab jǝr ǝman nasan ojarăn wan molekil tan n adu fal asan.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Molekil tan wǝn aman war ǝlen akayăd fal aman harat ehak ǝn turhăjăt haratan šund anăzmay azijăylălăn fal amăn.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Lam fal skate wan aɣeris ǝla ǝssǝn ǝšrutăn s ha tanăbajt ammas nasan. ǝšrutăn wǝn ǝssǝn n udif hullan n aɣeris hak alwaq wa ǝd takrămbay.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Fal as s darat n lam ăfroɣ, as lam tikrămbay ɣor ašrut ǝyyan s wa yadan, ašrut wa osăɣan ǝd aɣeris ǝnta a ǝfărraɣ.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Awen ǝtaqal addălǝl n ămlillay n skater. A fal skate tan ăstaɣan bren n aɣil , skater ad ehil bren n aɣil , a fal skate tan astăɣan s tǝšălje, skater ad ehǝl s tǝšălje.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: A fal arhăn s ǝddikod nasan n enerji wan s data, ahušăl tan ad abdin n enerji wa ǝd ifalan annur.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: ǝjan awen s asarɣi n partikil andarrat n ănnur s ǝsǝm net "foton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Siantifik tan ăɣran awen s "emisyon n radyasyon ăssigbăran" fal as atom tan war tan ehik ar ănnur amosan addalil n emisyon n foton wan annur tolas annur amos ǝššǝkil n radyasyon.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Tăswera tan tǝlkămat sakǝn atom tan zăzjărnen foton tan. Daɣ tǝditt, foton tan ojaran wǝ war nen taswera tămădrit hullan.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Foton tan ojăran tămmădrit harat wa daɣ ǝknan atom tan!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: ɣadu wa maqqoran n sistem wa ǝmătakwăyan amos olh s ǝnta a ǝntajan ăšni.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Ašni ǝtǝfil olh s ǝflukăn s ǝtawan agorš tan olh dihen eqqal ǝd olh daɣ iflukan s ismăwan nasan ǝzirwan. ǝflukan wǝ mădroynen hullan s ǝtăwan capillaries.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: kalad ăqlen seynen win triser atubs ădubin ad seqetesen tikărḍiwen n heckan haked teslăḍ ti eknănin iẓawi.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Urdăn kel musnet as traspur triser ǝtat asiksăt ,amus deɣ ǝni n heckăn kalad tila deɣ wetyan wǝ-s nǧăna aṭăbăcir.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: ǝcekrăc w-ǝd ulăhen d tecdăyen meḍruynin lan-ǝn tǝlila n ferkiten wǝ aknanin ămsud.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: kalad ămukan ad ǝseweǧ traysir ătubs akămkum nǝt yad ǝkes ǝfrkiten dat ad akec ǝlektăn.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ămijaɣen kel musnet ǝyeḍ as ǝheckăn w-ǝd ǝknin ăsem uǧec hulan , ɣas deɣ awǝn ăṣuhet atnet ăkcen dinăṣurten ,hulan as ălkeslăn d mudăren heḍnǝn ad ăǧmăḍnin dǝnăsorten ădubin ad ăkcen ǝferkiten wǝ ǝha asem , mǝɣ daɣ tǝhăyni nasen.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ăndik ămek was mad hǝ terkebt tănărkăbt n ayo,as tebdeded fel ăfella n ayo, ad yumăs ăḍkuḍ-nek daw awa tăǧed fel aqar n akal.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ăwadem wa as ăḍekuḍ nit 200 n arḍel (90 n kilogram ) fel akal ǝdḍăkeḍ 36 n arḍel (16 n kilogram)fel Io ,ɣas fel awǝn tănărkabt wer key I termes hullan.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: tefuk wer la aqer s nedubet tibeddi fel-as , tefuk tekna deɣ ălɣăzat ăḍuten d ăfiw d leblăzma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Ălgaz ǝtisdăd ayeka šănkǎšad fel tefuk.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Ăšrut wan ajjǎma n hăney ǝd nekyed deɣ tefuk ǝsem nit fotosfer, nta daɣ ăyămusen "tăkrurit n annur".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: ḍefer karaḍ ǧimăn n ăwatay , deɣ ăwatay wan 1610, ăswăkna umusnet wan iṭalya Galileo Galilei tiliskub yekăyad n ălkăwkab wan azohra ǝla isegugan , cund awa ǝteǧ ayor.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Tăǧǧent ishrutăn ful ǝnnin aɣǝl wan Venus (ǝwar)wa yellan ǝdis n tăfukt ɣas-nnit a ǝha afa. Ishrutăn wǝn Venis ssantamen turda tan Copernicus tan tennat as ǝmǝlăn eɣlayen fel tăfukt.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Tolas, haret n-ǝwetyan ḍarǎt awen, dagh ăwatay wan 1639, ǝnhay utumusnet ǝyen nakal wan Ingleter isem-nnit Jeremiah Horrocks, as Venus tukay.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Anleter tǝja azzǎmǎn šǎjren n alxer dǎrǎt atǎrmǝs n Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Kud awen ija ɣarid, daɣ awǎtǎy wan 991 ǝmmuqǎs Ethelred dajhɛn ntorfɛn naman wa ojaran nVikingtan darǝt wan Guthrum temede n awatǎy dat awen.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Ejhan wendaɣ n torfen tin aman azzǎrǎs Olaf Trygvasson, awǎdim n Norvej ǝlan derhan n uttǎr n-addǎwlat-nes daɣ alǝsteɣmǎr n Danemark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Darat ǝɣǎšodǎn win mǝlǝtertan, Ethelred addobǎt tǎnmerdut ǝd Olaf fal ǝšurutǎn, sǝnta eqqǎl Norvej yad erim akǎrǎš n almǎlikiya net s anǎjǎh ertǎyǎn.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul enta as tigemki ta tecrăyet s ammek wan adălaǧ d teglăt daɣ tămetti daɣ hak ahel. Tigemki tad tecrăyed daɣ 1444 daɣ amir wan ămnukal Sejong( 1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Amnukăl Sejong yemus ămnukăl wan ekkuẓ daɣ tămnukla tan Joseon d wa ytiwazzăyen hullan.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Daɣ tǝzăret iǧa isem wan Hunmin Geongeum ǝ tigemki tan Hangeul, was ira ad yenn(imesliten w-ǝẓalnǝn ful ǝrit n ăselmed n tǝmettǝwin).
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Llant tinfussin eǧutnint ful awa yeqqanen daɣ awa d-teffal tiǧemekki tan Sanskrit. Iyet teqqan daɣ ăssikel wan Aryan ser atăram har India, awayend tăwalt-nsen.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit tmus tăwalt ta terut tulăhet d tawalt tan Latin ta săwalen daɣ Eroba.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Elkettăb wa išwǎran atwizzay daɣ amăḍal yektab s Sanskrit. Dat ed ejjămεin Upanishads, Sanscrit texrak dat anălkom n harăten.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit tmus tawalt ta tesuhit d tănesbăɣurt hullan, kalla tmuss a-wa d-effalent twallin ămiẓlaynin tǝynăynin tǝn India, tulah d Latin ta tmusset awa d-effalnet tawalin cund Fransya d spanya.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Amǝr wad tesmenda France akennăs, Germany tessenta ăsemrumer ǝyad teǧǧec Isălăn tan Britania.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germany tǝgat "Operation Seallion". A yeǧin daɣ taẓuli ta teknat aẓuk d kayaten wǝn ǝmaknassen wǝn Britania exrakken daɣ ǝmir wad eǧemeḍen Dunkirk ful-awǝn ǝmaknassen war eṣṣuhin.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Bucan ămnukal Navy ugăr ǝmăknassen n Germany daɣ esṣăhet("Kriegsmarine") d yeddubbet ad ǝreẓẓa ǝtilla attǝyăra tan fuk n tădlemt siwăynin ser English Channel.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ful-ăwin, a-wa ntukken daɣ bato tan tin tămbukla tan Navy ekkrăssen ǝdis n ǝbărăqqaten wǝn tădlemt ful as ǝmnukăllen eksuḍen tǝwit ser agenna ser Germany.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ad nessentu s aseǧrăh n addăbăra tan wǝn Italia..Italia kala t-ămus hullan " amăḍray" wan Germany d Japan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Illa ǝrek alghăskǝr d ǝrek attǝyăra an , kunta ikjet d eknăn bato tan aynăynǝn dat tăsentut n ăkennas.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Itus wa meqquren wan italy enta as ikăllen win Afrikiya. Bach ad ermăssin ikjallen widih, ussaren tăqqemt, bach ad eddubbin ad ssikellin ser ăǧiriw wa mellen wan ămmas ful ad ăwḍin Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ful-awǝn iwăr-ten ad ereẓẓin Imăzzăghăn d bato tan win Britania daɣ Masar. Sel ǝǧitten widih, torfen tǝn akennăs n Italia war llǝn haret bach at-eǧǧin.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Amăra-daɣ ful japan. Japan kala ymus ăkal n ǝjǝrwăn cund Britania.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Sumaren tan anta yemmus bato tan yessǝkil daw n amăn , yeddubi ad yeqqim ddaw amăn alwaq iǧaten.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Sumarin tan sixdimănt daɣ ănemmănɣi n ikalen mdan wan I d ǝnemmănɣi wan II, llan aẓuk, tăblalt-nsen war tetugăg.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Daɣ ănemmănɣi tămeɣan fal aman andukan ɣas beccan as I yussa radar yunayer, tuǧaǧen daw amăn full inin icenga cwaden d-sen.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Sumaren tan wǝn Germany ǝsem-nit U-Boats. Ăddunet win Germany sanen ad seglen sumaren tan, llan musnet daɣ asăgel n sumaren tan.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Daɣ ǝddǝlil n-tarna-nǎssan fal iddim n-torfen nǎssan n-alçaskar tin dag amman ḍarat ǎkinnas, alman-tan war attǎwǎf lǎssan daɣas illan ajjen daɣsan.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Tǝdet, Tunxămun miɣ ganin-as "ămnikal Tut" meɣ "King Boy",iyyan dagh ămnukălăn yulăɣen daɣ ăɣrem n Masar, I ssanen-t ăddinet mdan.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Beccăn war illi ideg wa meqqăren daɣ aɣrem n iru, war illin daɣ umuɣ n imnukălen n Masar n mantatu.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: As ǧrăwen ăẓekka-nǝt daɣ ăwatay wa 1922 acel waɣ yeqqal haret i Aẓekka-nit war s-ǝǧriw haret yeqqim cund acel wa yezzăr. Wagi cund wiyaḍ.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Ak haret wa yenbălen d tăɣessa n Tutănkhamun daɣ ăẓekka eǧrăwen-tet temmus cund acel wa diɣ tetwănbel cund tirăwt d ăẓref, d ǝblălen tǝtwănafnen.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Eghăn n ǝdăran lănen rayon tan amos a eqqălen ufsăs ,armod d asidu i agmod n militer tan d torkăten t-ǝyyad n Assyrian.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Allăɣăn năsen naq-in ăddinet wi ǝlsan iselsa n tazuli, 1000 tizan ara n ɣisa Assiryen llan icenga n iysan antenni ǝ-yezzaren.

text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ful uǧuǧ wa uǧaǧen wiyuḍ daɣ pueblos, war teddubid ad teǧrawed tamudri tan iheḍ as wer tessukaled ɣur Albuquerque miɣ Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Sit ful awin, casinos wis-kallad nennin hakken, ɣared-nsen, tisessi, d ayeǧin d-sen tawiyend imeclan wi lanin isem wan azenhi (hullan wi maqqurnin d wi aɣlaynin i Albuquerque d Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Kaccida: bars wi ntuknin win iɣarman wi maḍruynin abadah mmussen ideggan ahussiyen i imaǧaren.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Daɣ aɣil iyen, afella wan Mexico wa aynayen illa tikerrass tmeqqurnin n alaway s ammek war uliɣen d ahannay wan analway war ihussi idis n bars iɣerman wi ntuknin.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Atiwezay afanɣ fel alxeyaḍen ta werin ahusket d temcerweyin as afnaɣ fel alxeyaḍ.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Amarad daɣ allant sesanǧalen win grafiti, d ameken win Afanaɣ fel elxeyaḍen ti alkemnin yelqanun , deɣ aǧut nesnet lakemnet yektab fel elxeyaḍ deɣ awin isesnǧilen wi ahusktnin, ufen harten wi wer in anfalel.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: A Hangi tamus amensi ikanen deɣ taǧaca terɣat deɣ akal.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Tagaca tahi sikusentet s tegadayin arɣanin, miɣ deɣ degan wi teǧanin tuksi tan sidir tan dag akal semek amukanen.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi daɣ taǧentet i asukes n amensi cund isan fel afiw.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Idegan aǧutnin deɣ Rotorua Hangi, tukse n akal, deɣ as amuken aḍakal n keyaden deɣ Hangi deɣ Christchruch Wellington, d degan heḍnin.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail anta illa sin iswiren dag trains wa n banlieus MetroPlus (aswir wa izaren) d mitru anta aswir wan sin.
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Daɣ MetroPlus amessukel ad isunfu hullan becca ilek yassuhed becca wergi cund ilek dag lmitru wa n lurup.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ak train tella illa MetroPlus d Metro, MetroPlus anta abada ilkam i train wa yuhaẓen Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Asiweḍ ɣur wiyeḍ - war tekyaden dag kayaten i tewwayeḍ ɣur-k kud id-teffaled akal iyen.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Teddubit ad tegrawed iman-nek tewwayed haret wa igdalen kay wer tessaned, ad tegrawed iman-nek tewwixled.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Waɣ kkanen-t daɣ idgan n aqqal, iḍen gamyen awa tewwayeḍ, dubin ad agrawen droug, akayad waɣ war ma tessaned.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Llan ikalen suhden dag lxukm-nsen kud grawen ɣur-k haret wa igdalen dag akal-nsen teddubid ad tegrawed iman-nek 10 iwetyan dag lxabs.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Full inin ak acel tettemhayed d haret n twekkiwin daɣ ihenna, urdiɣ war ddubin ak-sirinen.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: As tellid daɣ akal iyen, axuten illan diɣ war ten-tezdayed uksaḍ full iman-nek, iga mici fell-ak.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Kud tellid daɣ akal yekkus, tiwekka d baktirya tazalent hullan, ddarent hullan daɣ tafekka.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Abada Delhi Belly talɣan Pharaon's Curse,Montezuma's Revenge d ak imidiwen-nit.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Cund daɣ idgen semmiden tella turna n anfu, tella turna n awsa daɣ idgen wi yekkusen, daɣ sin war hussayen.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: As tessukled berrin akal yettimɣar miɣ irna, war teksuḍed as tnayet aserti daɣ agna.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Llan imessukal ibuɣar, ermaɣen as siklen daɣ ikalen yunayen miɣ ikalen anduknin timɣaren, sitin-d haret iyen daɣ agna.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Daɣ icilan wi yezzarnin, eǧ awa i yellan daɣ iɣef-nek, daɣ titetti d ak haret. Daɣ isensa kanen cund miden n akal n afla, awa ihussayen, abada ar tewwilfed.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Uksad ad teṭased full amaḍal daɣ idgen wi war tessaned axuten i yellan diɣ.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: As tekkid tiniri awi tadabut miɣ haret iyen n iḍes, uksaḍ taxut miɣ ifiɣerqes.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: S tufat ekken iyet n lqahwa teǧǧudi, s tadeggat eccew iyen n lkas n cahi, ihussay hullan full ssahet.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: As tekkit asarag teddubit a tekned awa trid full inin ad tessunfut, eǧ iweẓlan warǧi wi n ak acel.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Kud tamused awadem iran asikel, eccew haret n tisessi cund lɣasir.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Urdiɣ ad tessanet haret n tissit, a tekkanet daɣ ameǧi-nek kud tehhusay, as twilifed.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Kud tezzaɣed dag aɣrem wa yella dag agna-nit tisessi tegget, ak idgen wi llanin lbar, wi war tessaned.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: I miden wi waren ssin tawalt n idabiben, tifras ‘’infectious d contagious'' war ulin, war ugdan.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Turna ta itelyaɣen anta sebba-nit haret iyen cund virus, infafaden, tiwekka, baktirya miɣ haret iyen.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Turna ''contagious'' anta turna tettilteɣ as tuhaẓed miɣ teqqimed dat n awadem irin.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Idabuyen aǧetten, kud tessukled berrin akal--nsen, aK-sestennen full kud teǧǧid tidag full haret n turna.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Titar tiɣ taǧen-tent full imessukal i iffalen akal iyen, miɣ full imaǧaren.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Harret daɣ titbaqqa ti yṣohatnin tin Charlotte, daɣ North Carolina, enta as teḍna daɣ harraten wi nfanin aɣiwan.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Imezzagh wid iffalnin ikallen wihadhnin Jannin as yegraz'asen asimghar n aghiwan fulawin as sekresen ihanan nsen dindagh, imajaren yejraz'asen aghrem win s tidawt n arraten.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Dagh 20 n awatay oukaynin, harraten win nfanin arraten dagh Uptown Charlotte ssatin s ammek Wa meqqoren.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ddinet win izzaɣen dag Charlotte war ttawnen turefin n usiweḍ, beccan turfin tiɣ tililant midden wiyaḍ dag imir iyen.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Illa iyen n iket a t-tessitit as tellid uǧar n sin 2 imessukal diwen d kay, aferran waɣ isuhed hullan.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctiq amos edag wa ikna assamed ujis hullen fal akal, tolas eɣlay id Pole wan tamasna.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Isikilan win turist tan assohen hullan, azilzaman assexat n taɣissa, addoben ad aj in daɣ awelan Nov-Feb, tolas akkimalan hullan ɣur Peninsula, Islands d Ross sea.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Iddikud ən efad n-amašaɣal a izzaɣan dihen s awelan dǎɣ akkoz dozen-tan ihandagan iyyad n-ikallan win; iddikud andarran itayɣam dihen s tagrist.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Inland Antarctica amos Plateau tilat tahanint ilsa aɣeris fal 2 har 3 kilometir tan.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Harat dǎɣ imusanan n-isaɣliyan takkin inland, i anay n idaɣan meɣ ag-ad ən Pole ilan edag maqqoran.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Paul Traverse( migh abaraqqa Wa yermadhen) yougeg fel McMurdo Station aylan1600km dagh ijjiriw Wan Russ.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Entta as agharis Wa yentakken han iqqaren hanten tikkasitin. War teddubid assikel sersen kounta War llint toureffin ti tent ijbadnin ihint amekchi d Fuel.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Awin War ha taytti houllan, fell awin iwarti ad awi abaraqqa Wa yeghlayen i isoullal Transantarctic foul irit ad awdhen takerkourt.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Tamentilt ta tezzaret n accidents enta as abaraqqa Wa ichadhen d pavements hakked steps.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: S ammek ifnaz'en, ywarkay ad tejrawed tibouhajin s soles iknanin. Tibouhajin win awilen dagh ajout nsen War niheggan d igharis, hakked haret dagh tibouhajin tin tagrest War oulighent.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Tibouhajin lazem ad oumasnet tichejroutnin, 5mm( 1.5 adhad) migh atougaren, hakked haret was ikkan yelzem ad oumas ifessoussen dagh amir Wan isamidh.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Tibouhajin tiyoudh llant isennanen s iris, llant dagh ammekken wiyoudh anihejjanin d igharis, gantenet dagh ajout n tibouhajin d ifekklan dagh Iris nesnet.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ifekklan lazem ad oumassen intouknin chejroutnin, dagh Idahi migh az'z'ed migh( calcium Chloride) abadah ellwan dagh ibaraqqaten foul irit ad ilalen i amoussou.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Udhou n igharis wajjigh haret Wan Bennan. Wa yerresen houllan War tat'afen ar ndharren, d awa ychadhen ad oudhou chound Avalanches.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Almouchkilat enta as igharis ilattagh, foul awin yelzemas haret watd isoudhoun, hakked igharis Wa yeggaten yeddubbet ad yesoudhou Awa yeqqimen.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Amir iyen, Awa tisoudhoun enta as tafoukt ta tlaffaghet igharris, amir iyen assiwedh n igharis, amiren ajjoutnin awadem.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornado enta as adhou Wa yeghllayen dagh pressure ifnaz'en n air, Wa yjjabbaden air har ammas d afella.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Ttajjet adhou as'ouhin( dagh ajout girl 100 d 200 miles/hours), dagh yeddoubet ad it'kel harraten iknanint az'ouk dagh agenna, tewwayten dagh ideg Wa tekka.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Tezoubeted toullah d ibaraqqaten wid iffalnin tijrakkattin , ad teqqel " Tornadoes" as tedhas amadhal.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Personel VPN enta as harret oullaghen foul irit n circumventing d aseddou n political censorship hakked IP-geofiltering.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ouggaren Proxy Web foul timental ajoutnint, elwayen internet Trafic imda, wajjigh http ghas.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Hakken Bandwidth Wa meqqouren d qualite n service ta toulaghet. Entanidh encrypted adi yez'ewwet ad amar.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Media companies jannin bahouten foul ittous n haret wagh, jjanin as yemous” prevent piracy”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Adi, region code War tadhissen illegal copying; bit-for-bite n disk will teglat dagh ittilla amatouj wadagh igla original will.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Itoous Wan tiddet enta as ad ekkfin companies nesen ougar n control dagh essoukiten nssen, awin yeqqal asseghllay n az'ref.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Foul innin issiwallen aqqanen dagh internet , War hakk ilzem ad tejjed phone compagny dagh ideg wadagh tazzaghed migh Wa tekhadamed.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: War hakk iwar dagh ad tejjed local number dagh tametti tadagh tazzaghed; teddibid ghas a tejjed satellite internet connection dagh chicken tayz'ewwin, dagh Alaska, wad tesnefrened midhen innin as tensid daw tafoukt tan Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Abaddah, yewarki atejjenched global number amiz'layen foul arrit ad eddoubbin PSTN phones ahak ssiwlen. Awa diffal midhannnek temmous haret Wa yez'emmiz'layen wi hak issawalen.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Real-time texte translator aps-applications enta as amatouj Wa yeddoubbin ad issoughel tiz'ounawin mdanet n texte n tawalt iyet har tawalt iyet hadhet.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Haret dagh applications n wagh category eddoubbin dagh ad soughalen texte dagh tawalin amiz'laynin foul harraten dagh amadhal Wan tiddet dagh alwaq wadagh awadem yesseghlayti brin harraten widih.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Translation engin amoukenen houllan abadah hakken translation tan tidet, bouchan yewar awadem ad ouksadh, foullas yeddoubet as eghchaden.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Iyet dagh apps ti yez’allnin dagh category wagh enta as Google translate, enta yeidoubet ad yejj tasoughelt dat ad tawiyed desired language data.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Asekhedem n GPS navigation dagh smartphone nnek, yeddoubet ad oumas harret Wa hakk ilallen Bach ad telwayed dagh akkal warlid.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Yeddoubet ahak izefnez' dagh az'ref, ouffa ad tjenched MAPS aynayen migh amatouj Wan GPS ghasnnit migh ad tardheled amatouj ser car rental company.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: As warlid data connection dagh phone nnek, migh War iha reseau, tidebba nnit eddoubnet ad fnaz'net migh abattent fou.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Hakk coner idhnay dagh pre-paid phone cards tis teddubid agent sakhdamed dagh pay phone migh ordinary telephones.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Nessan as ajout n cards oulaghnet foul irit n assiwel dagh idtilla ideg, harret desnet yegdahasnet as hakken araz'am ifnaz'en foul irit n ad tssiwled brin teddukkilin tiyoudh dagh ikkallen.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ad tawdhed ghur services wagh s tilalet n midhen n phone Wa War iha az'ref was teddoubbid ad tessiwled sers dagh ittilla phones bennan.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Rules wi artaynin d photography oullahnet d tin video recording, yeddoubet as ougarten.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: kounta ad tet'fed photo ghas ymous haret Wa itiwagdalen, Adi wer teddubid ad tezzinejoumed dagh ad tejjed video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Kounta tsakhdamed drone , essen s tizaret kounta teddoubbid ad tejjed video d mamoussen permits migh liscensing wi hadhnin wi has ilzamen.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ad tsigedded drone ouhaz' airport migh afella taddukkilt n midden ymous haret War iwar sarhou, koundabba War itiwagddal awin dagh akal nnek.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Ar ahlwagh, issikallen dagh ajenna War nnifrennen sel oummough d az'emmez'li gir atoujjen ammiz'laynin.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Amir iyen, flight iyen yeddoubet ad ikrech atoujjen amiz'laynin dagh tmattiwin ammiz'laynin, foulawin iwar ittilla awadem ad immagh dagh website n Airline iman nnit.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: kounta War hakk ilzem visa Bach atejjenched ikkallen wiyoudh as tmoussed amajjar migh foul iwez'lan, ad tejjeched chound analmad yelzemas ad teqqimed alwaq maqqouren i adtejjeched chound casual tourist.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Dagh ajout, iyad teqqimed dagh akkal warlid aylan alwaq yejjin yelzemak ad tawid visa s tizaret.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Student visas dagh ajout llat requirements amiz'laynin d application procedures War oulihent d normal tourist migh business visas.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Dagh ayejjin n ikkallen, telzemak tirawt sers taneghrit tas terhid atetekked foul tighri, hakked Awa yettbatten tella nnek as teddoubbid i tamoudri dagh iwetyan wi izzarnin dagh almoud nnek.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Essen dagh institution, hakked dagh immegration departement n akkal wadagh terhid ad telmeded, foul irit ad telmeded detailed requirements.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Sel as tmoussed diplomat, awiz'let dagh akal warlid yelzemak ad tekkfed awa tellid dagh ihiri d tella Wa llid dagh akkal nnek.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Araz'am foul ihiri imiz'lay gir ikallen mdan, hakked tafoult n araz'am War toulih gir akkal d Wa hadhen.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Dagh ikkallen win fideral, chound United state d Canada, raz'amen foul ihiri dagh ikallen win local d win federal, foul awin yeddoubet ad imiz'liy araz'am gir ideg d wahadhen.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Lmed s awa teddoubbid d awer teddoubbid tenned Awa ichadhen.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ammek Wa nahhilen foul ad tessentemed dagh asentem n issikilen enta as ad tekkned almoud nnek dagh established travel blog website.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: As tennummed formatting an editing dagh web, dat awin, teddoubbid da tarred website nnekk.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ad tejjed voluntaring ymous haret oullaghen Bach ad tejjed a yemmizziyen, bouchan wajjigh ghas foul Awa hakked.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Tamoudri d amoukenen n voluntaring dagh akal warlid imous haret wasi telmeded foul agnaten amiz'laynin, iyad temhayed d midden wihadhnin, iyad tellmede hakked foul immannek, iyad d teqqeled hakked ad tekreched mousnatin tiynaynin.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Awa yeddoubet ad oumas haret wasi tekreched az'ref s ad tejened dagh ideg iyen s alwaq Wa yehoujjan, foul innin ayejjin dagh volunteer hakken taghahamt d imekchi, wiyoudh raz'emmen hakked az'ref.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikings ardhallend tarrayin tin Russes foul ad awdhen ijiriw Wa sat'afen d ijiriw Wan Caspian. Haret dagh tarrayin tidagh yeddoubet as sikhdamentenet harwah. Essenet foul haret was yeddoubet ahas tejrawem speciale permits, tis yeddoubet as yez'ewwet aten tassem.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Ighazzar Wa mallen Wan Baltic yeqqan ajelmam Wan Arctique ghur ijjiriw Wan Baltic, ser ajelmam Wan Onega, ajelmam Wan Ladoga, d saint-petersbourg, ayejjin desen ser ighazaren ijelmamen.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Ajelmam Wan Onega yeqqan hakked enta dagh volga, ady teddoubbid daagh ad tassed ijiriw Wan Caspian ser Russia .
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ywarkay ad tetbatted as tewwededh Marinas, hakk haret ymous Bennan.ad temhayed d hitchihikers iyad ouz'anen dek issalan nsen .
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Hak haret, ad tejjed imessakniten wi ytataren ahak ilallen, wad tsoukaled ibaraqqaten, wad tahez'ed midden wi takkasnin irdan dagh tisnitin nasen, Wad tertayed d kelaman dagh imsesswan, d harraten chound wiyagh.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Arem ad tmijreded d ayejjin dagh midden.dat awin akay ezziyen emdan Wa kay ekffen tmmal n tasnit ta temmaght i awadem iyen.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Yewarki ad tsenbefrened Airline company nnek houllan.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: koundebba teghilked inahillen iyad tejrawed ideg dagh tasnit taskallad teddiwed des, yewarki ad telmeded as haret en wi thakk emmiz'laynin.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Airlines chound Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines ssiwedhen elkhedmet nsen har Africa , d tellat tissaqin ajoutnint d ikkallen wihadhnin s az'ref ifnaz'en.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish airlines tajjet assikel dagh 39 n ideggan d 30 ikkalen dagh Africa men 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: As tellid elwaq yessatin, essen mnikawa hi tz'emaz'liyed gir araz'am nnek brin Africa d brin amadhal imda.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Warhin tettewed ad tssited araz'am foul ajmoudh d assikel Wan amadhal d harraten wiyoudh dagh Africa
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: As tegheheled assikel dagh amadhal chound southern, elmed as asennefren n issikilen efnaz’en foul innin War tilla abaraqqa deneg ijjiriw.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Aserti d idtella company War ihakk assikel dagh ibaraqqaten ghared.
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Amagal n awin, star alliance tesddiw hakk haret sel ajous Wan tiheljji n ijiriw south pacific, men santiagode chile har Tahiti, enta as assikel Wan LATAMA Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Deɣ awatay wan 1994 , iǧaḍed acrut wan nagorno-Karabakh wan arminten deɣ akal wan azrabijan aknas fel azareyin.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: As telilt n armenten , ikna akal aynayen , mucin haked awin wer tella akal ibdaden fel man-it haked armenya wer seres tesurhaǧ.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Tegla tamajaq n diplomatie fel kalen wi ɣacadnin amken ǧir Armenya d Azrabijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Aɣil wa n tiṭ (Dutch : Grachtengordel) anta ideg wa illan amasru dag lqarn wan mraw d asa 17, iɣlay Binennstade wan Amerdame.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Amus aɣil windeɣ a atiwazayen s ihendeg n Agna d takasit n akal ɣred deɣ yuniskou fel atuǧ n agna d mentatu wi tet hanin d atuǧ wa la nta ayuǧaren deɣ awind ɣered deɣ akal.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Tcinkou tiri, ta tamuset semus kalen , tekna deɣ semuset ɣermatin tin aǧama n aǧariw ti amusnin , riomaǧuri, d manarola ,d kurenǧilya d firnaza d montirouso ta het acrut wan ligorya tan iṭalya.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Teha daɣ taẓageẓt n kalen tan yuniskou i takasit n kalen.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ayukayen timaḍ n wetyan deyan adinet ,trasat s amek ahuskin ulaɣen fel agama wa iknan aṣahet tehit tasatararut ta tewayet s ti akyadnin deɣ aǧariw.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Tecem n tehussay nit atamusen afanaz deɣ haraten wi aynaynin ,deɣ kayaden adinet , usaɣen bardan d baraqaten d batuten tiɣarmatin , wer adubetnet turfin atet ded aǧcnet deɣ tefari.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Tawalt tan tefrnsist temiẓlay deɣ adeweni nit deɣ beljika d suisra ameẓli anḍaren wer-in amun fel meǧred wa tet taǧen kel france , kudeɣ as nta tamun tegdeh yad tetǧreh semek ulaɣen ahuskin.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: S idem amunen amek n asiḍan deɣ beljika d suisra wi asiwelnin s tefrensit ta tetwasawalet deɣ franca, deɣ as amiẓley teɣri n tefir teyeḍ.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Haked kud iǧa awin kel beljika d kel swisra wi asiwelnin tefrnesit , ad lmeden tefrensit tan teɣari , ɣas deɣ awin adubin akey aǧrahen haked kud teswaẓlid amek n aselmad n tefrensit wa yugdahen.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Deɣ tecem n akal amus ulf s afus idawni iwayen tefirt tan manawin.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Haked deɣ awin deɣ malizya , ǧir malayu deɣ teɣermatin , as awaind amus ayaw, cund amus wa taǧa teɣessa n awadem , temus amek n uǧrih taǧen kel ɣerman weyeḍ n ataram , amus daɣ wad wer iteǧ ar yawad ɣas.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Cund , adubet ad iceɣced amasakul n britanya deɣ ispanya yad iseslem fel awdem s adikel ,idikel wenin utas heret iyen sidis , cund amek n uɣel
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Tawalin tin talilt amusnet tawalin aknain miɣ daynin aknant yad serɣesnet anmiwaḍ ǧir temetiwin tis amus aǧrawnet tikaras deɣ anmiwaḍ ,awa imeẓlayen d awin.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Nta tebḍa fel lingua francas,amusnet daɣ tawalin amunin miɣ tin telaḍ , aqlnet atilan ded iway alweq amusnet amek n anmiwaḍ ɣur adinet wi asiwelnin tawalin ti heḍnin.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Deɣ ammas n acel , imesukal adubin ad armen iylel wa iseknin aman miɣ (hareten heḍnin).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Adubet ad tumas haret labasen as ilkem amasakul i iylel d abaxas n aman d aṣahet ta ded teqimet.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Haked tenariwden ti eknanin tuksi adubetnet ad aknenet tesemḍi hullan deɣ aheḍ , temus tenedi haret labasen , kunta wer ilsa awadem iselsa sikusnin.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Deɣ awilen hulan iwaraneɣ ad neǧ aneyet i tadast , kunta nerha axewes deɣ ferǧan wi fel agaten ǧenawen.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Haked kud tacicaled tureft nek deɣ cekrac wi fel ikna aǧna iwit ,ɣas haret n alweq windeɣ i teǧed tired asher n tureft-nek , awin alweq iknan ugdih i tadast ya dek teni deɣ turef.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Tedubet ad termes turhena tan eǧḍaḍ , miɣ aǧburu n eǧḍaḍ ad irmes iǧḍaḍ d mudare.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Atwalaɣet ayarun as alant ayukayen ifeḍ n tekrist deɣ adinet mucan acrut nit iyen kalad ineq.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Asaharen adinet wi uhernin d kazan , mucin haked awin adinet abḍan adinet wi elkamnin i egḍaḍ han mici wan turhena.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Awa atwezyen deɣ anerwiǧ as aǧut n zezǧar d ɣecran , aknanin atrur , tirenet daɣ abarid i aman yad atruren.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Itaɣsan wigh Deɣ agut.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.
